# OA v0.7.26

**Status:** Public development preview

**Release date:** 2026-08-29

**Source:** [`v0.7.26`](https://github.com/realminc/oa/releases/tag/v0.7.26)

## Summary

OA v0.7.26 is the immutable Python-publication repair for the blocked v0.7.25
candidate. It retains the native Vulkan Video milestone and the v0.7.25 shader
authority and validation-logger repairs without changing public APIs, codec
admission, media fixtures, or performance evidence.

## Fixed

- Converted both Python runtime presentation-fallback warnings from legacy
  `%s` placeholders to OA's brace-formatting contract.
- Made the Python lifecycle test force an invalid presentation backend. The
  compute-only fallback and its warning are now tested on hosts with or without
  a working desktop session.
- Regenerated the public root stub to remove one stale overload docstring found
  by the generator-owned crypto-host check.

## Verification

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| Python extension | Fresh Release `_oa` target links successfully |
| Python lifecycle regression | Forced presentation failure passes 3/3 and creates a compute-only engine |
| Python wheel profiles | Host 36/36; crypto-host 8/8; zero selected skips |
| Prior hosted gates | v0.7.25 full Build & Test, ASAN, UBSAN, CPU Vulkan, C++ release assets, and checksums passed |
| Hosted release | Workflow-owned: wheel build/install/smoke, PyPI, full build/packages, sanitizers, CPU Vulkan, release assets, and checksums |

The complete codec correctness, Vulkan validation, and benchmark evidence is
unchanged and remains in the [video benchmark](../benchmarks/oaVideo.md) and
[v0.7.24 source note](v0.7.24.md).

## Compatibility and migration

There are no public API or data-format changes in this repair. Rebuild native
and Python consumers and discard pre-1.0 binary, pipeline, execution-plan, and
media-session caches.

## Known limitations

The video capability limits recorded for v0.7.25 are unchanged. Self-hosted
GPU validation remains runner-dependent and is reported separately from hosted
CPU-Vulkan and sanitizer results.
